name: Thrill Wave
tagline: Real insight to real trust, captured on camera.
defaultDescription: Thrill Wave is a Phoenix, AZ video production company. We find stories worth caring about, capture them beautifully and tell them with impact.
summary: Thrill Wave is a video production company in Phoenix, Arizona. Before picking up a camera, the team runs a SITREP (situation report): research into the client's organization, audience and competitive landscape that decides which story is worth producing. Then they film it documentary-style and plan its distribution. Clients range from Fortune 500 brands to healthcare practices, non-profits and tribal governments.
ogImageAlt: Thrill Wave logo over a close-up of a finger on a recorder's REC MODE button

team.name: Ari Everett
team.bio: Ari makes sure everyone is taken care of. He carries every project from the first conversation to the final delivery and treats each client, crew member and deadline like it matters, because to him it does.

team.name: Tony Swann
team.jobTitle: Co-Founder, Director and Director of Photography
team.bio: Tony directs with patience and a big heart. He makes people feel at ease in front of the camera so the real moment shows up, then frames it with an artist's eye.

team.name: Chris Kuzman
team.bio: Chris asks the questions that get to the heart of things. He turns research into the story worth telling, so the work means something to the people it's made for.
